correctness.rationale: For all fixed d>=1 and q any prime power, the six-variable Euler product using I_r(q) for irreducible monic P encodes equality of ordered triple products. Factoring Z=prod_{i,j}(1-q x_i y_j)^(-1) cancels top q-degree in each homogeneous bidegree. The only bidegree-2 deficit-one logarithmic term is -q e2(x)e2(y); all bidegrees m>=3 have q-degree <=m-2 and products of corrections cannot recreate deficit one. Target coefficient extraction gives M_d q^(3d)-9 N_d q^(3d-1)+O_d(q^(3d-2)); inclusion-exclusion evaluates M_d=(d+1)(d+2)(d^2+3d+4)/8 and N_d=d(d+1)(d+2)(3d+1)/24. Fresh independent exact enumeration of all 3x3 contingency matrices for d=1..10 agrees, and direct triple polynomial product enumeration p=2,3,5 d<=3 confirms degree-one exact 6q^3-9q^2+4q and supports the lower-order behavior. Explicit formal Euler logarithmic degree bound establishes the unrestricted fixed-d statement, not finite enumeration.
residual_risks: No uniform-in-d constant or full exact polynomial in q claimed.
The formal logarithmic filtration, though reconstructed, was not Lean-formalized.
